_about.purpose: Track catalogue for the music-video pipeline: the source audio, its generation prompt, and the lyrics/themes that drive section planning. Each entry is one song from the user's own library.

schema.tracks[].id: stable identifier used by presets and saved jobs
schema.tracks[].filename: audio filename as it appears in the audio library
schema.tracks[].source_path: original path on the generation machine; NOT a valid path on this one
schema.tracks[].music_prompt: the prompt that generated the track; reused for visual tone matching
schema.tracks[].lyrics: theme summary used for section planning (not full lyrics)
schema.tracks[].visual_style / visual_prompt: empty until a visual treatment is chosen; fill these to pin a style
schema.tracks[].status: pending until the video has been generated

_about.extending: Add an entry per track. Keep id and filename in sync with the audio library; a filename that no longer resolves will 404 in the track picker.
